facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay 975 gold, three-quarters price for the barrow treasure, once the supply caravans flow again. It cannot be collected until then.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note was offered to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_62), so it is unclear whether the party still holds it or how much of its value is still the party's.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda their hire for joining the dragon hunt, to be paid from Cedric's promissory note once the caravans flow again.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not say whether the note was handed over or its proceeds were promised, nor how the payment is split.
